# beta-MnO2 LR-U complete numerical appendix

This is the human-readable numerical supplement to the accompanying mathematical evidence report. It is rendered directly from [`../../evidence_audit_feo_20260812.json`](../../evidence_audit_feo_20260812.json), whose values were independently parsed from the native SIESTA archive.

## Conventions

Site index 0--15 means MnLR00--MnLR15.  `BARE` uses the second complete semantic occupation event; REFERENCE and SCREENED use the last. The finite-difference denominator is 0.10 eV.  The displayed response matrices are symmetrized as `(M_raw + M_raw.T)/2`; the raw arrays are in the JSON supplement.
